method: Individually visually inspected model-derived HLR PNGs
notes: Camera for yoke/frame pin entry is oppositeY to wedge-slot view to expose corresponding openings; source basis included per figure. Bank is a nominal source envelope, not exact measured hardware.

figures.name: bank_placement_with_bank
figures.finding: Nominal rounded bank visible seated inside cradle, both separated42mm from camera carrier. Four frame joint relationships shown; no fabricated ports. Camera electronics omitted to expose printed geometry.

figures.name: yoke_pin_stage
figures.finding: OppositeY view exposes rectangular entry aperture and pin tip with a clear gap. Pin translated+24localY; actual insertion-localY.

figures.name: yoke_wedge_stage
figures.finding: Short wedge separated above seated pin; transverse slot visible on right, direct downward localZ path.

figures.name: yoke_lock_seated
figures.finding: Pin and short wedge seated in actual yoke/carrier joint; crop documented as a section, not an independent part.

figures.name: frame_pin_stage
figures.finding: Actual frame pin translated+24localY, entry aperture visible below frame bridge; long wedge omitted until following action.
